Rae Johnson: Quick kickoff for CloudHarbor co-marketing: marketplace listing, joint webinar, blog + benchmark blurb, and lead routing into SFDC. Can we do a 25m dry-run Thu 9:30am PT?
Tom Alvarez: Thu 9:30 works. Key checks: CTA param pass-through, hero perf screenshot, webinar slide deck order, and SFDC field mapping.
Maya Li: I'll own the blog draft and listing copy. Plan: short hero line, 3 bullets, and a small benchmark callout. Keep messaging product-forward.
Sana (CloudHarbor): CloudHarbor comms can provide anonymized traces and a 1-sentence partner quote. Legal wants a methodology note; okay if you add a sentence.
Ellen Park: SFDC mapping: use lead_source=cloudharbor_marketplace, utm_campaign=cloudharbor_q2, partner_account=CloudHarbor, owner_queue=partners_sdr_queue. Also route utm_medium=marketplace leads to partner queue.
Rae Johnson: Registration fields minimal: name, email, company, role, interest checkbox, partner opt-in. Add hidden `marketplace_click_id`.
Tom Alvarez: I'll prepare a 30s failover clip and size the perf hero PNG for the listing. Also will mock the pre-record in the drive.
Maya Li: Benchmark ask: Sana, can you confirm CloudHarbor will allow publishing aggregate numbers? We want a conservative stat (e.g., ~20% cost saving with caching) plus a methodology blurb.
Sana (CloudHarbor): Yes, we can share aggregated numbers. Legal approves if methodology blurb present. We'll send the quote and logo by Wed AM.
Ellen Park: Add a smoke test to rehearsal: use the test lead generator to post a lead with marketplace_click_id and confirm SFDC fields map. Marketing-bot, can you create the test endpoint?
marketing-bot: Test lead generator created: https://api.redwood/test-lead?marketplace_click_id=test123&utm_campaign=cloudharbor_q2. Shortlink for registration: https://go.redwood/cloudharbor-launch. UTM defaults set.
Rae Johnson: Great. Action list: Maya - blog + listing copy (Wed EOD). Tom - slides + failover clip + hero PNG (Wed EOD). Ellen - SFDC mapping + smoke test (Thu AM). Sana - logo + quote + permission (Wed AM).
Tom Alvarez: I'll add the CTA param-preserve check to the rehearsal checklist. If the marketplace requires redirect, we'll implement client-side redirect preserving UTMs.
Maya Li: Will include a 2-line benchmark box and a one-paragraph methodology note: "Joint internal tests on sample catalogs; results may vary by workload."
Sana (CloudHarbor): Confirmed. We'll provide anonymized trace CSV and short quote Wed AM.
Ellen Park: I'll run the staging SFDC mapping and validate after rehearsal. Add marketing-bot test lead to the checklist.
Rae Johnson: Thanks team  I'll post a pre-read Wed morning with links to assets. Keep claims conservative and include the methodology blurb on listing and blog. See you Thu. :rocket:
